pages.raw_title: Transforming how the world treats pain – Pacira BioSciences
pages.raw_meta: Better is possible. Join us in reimagining pain management with innovative, non-opioid therapies for chronic, postsurgical and musculoskeletal pain.
raw_blocks: Better Pain Management is Possible
More than 18 million patients have been treated with Pacira non-opioid therapies. We are building on that foundation every day.
Our goal is to expand treatment options and partner across healthcare to make non-opioid therapies the standard, not the exception.
Our commercial portfolio spans postsurgical, chronic, and musculoskeletal pain. Our pipeline includes a gene therapy candidate for knee osteoarthritis.
Pain affects every part of life. We help patients understand their options and advocate for non-opioid care with their providers.
Pacira was built on the belief that patients deserve better options. Our team works across science, education and advocacy to make that real.
Science that refuses to settle
Our commercial therapies address postsurgical, chronic, and musculoskeletal pain.

Our investigational pipeline includes PCRX-201, a gene therapy candidate for knee osteoarthritis, and is poised to transform how we approach osteoarthritis treatment with the goal of helping patients return to normal function.
We remain committed to advancing therapies backed by rigorous, peer-reviewed clinical evidence.
Better conversations lead to better care. We equip patients and caregivers with the resources to explore non-opioid options and partner with their providers on a plan built around them.
Partnering to advance access, education, and advocacy

Expanding access to non-opioid options requires working across the full healthcare system, with providers, policymakers, and patient advocates. More than 40 million people now have coverage for post surgical pain therapies and outpatient surgeries through commercial and governmental plans including the NOPAIN act. We are committed to continuing that progress.
Join us in making a difference
Our teams are united by a passion for excellence and a commitment to patients. Here, you can grow your career while making a real impact.

pages.raw_title: A leader in innovative pain management – About Pacira
pages.raw_meta: Our mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients. Learn how we put our mission into action.
raw_blocks: Leading the future of pain management
Pacira is shaping the future of pain management — with a portfolio of two commercial non-opioid therapies, an active pipeline, and a mission that extends well beyond the clinic.
Our mission is to deliver innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to transform the lives of patients.
Our guiding principles are mantras we developed in lockstep with our mission, influencing every decision we make.
Keep the patient at the center
Pain is deeply personal, often overwhelming even the simplest daily tasks. Every decision we make is grounded in the needs and experiences of our patients.
Science is the foundation upon which we build our innovations, ensuring safety, efficacy, and meaningful outcomes.
Our team is our strength. Fairness, respect, and equity are the cornerstones of our culture, creating a supportive environment where everyone can thrive.
How we do anything is how we do everything

Our ONE Pacira culture is the fabric that unites our team’s passion for excellence and the patients we serve. Our guiding principles were developed in lockstep with our mission and are influential in every decision we make.
Learn more about life at Pacira
Every day we are determined to achieve the extraordinary
Guided by our commitment to keep the patient at the center, we recognize that every day matters for a patient suffering in pain.
Integrity is the foundation of who we are
We believe in transparency, accountability, and honesty, and we have the fortitude to make difficult decisions for the greater good.
We respect diverse talent and the collective power of a unified team
We recognize the role of teamwork toward tackling challenges, and we believe in the value of different experiences and perspectives.
Driving change in pain management
Guided by science, driven by integrity, and united by one purpose: to help reduce the impact of pain on people’s lives. Because better care isn’t optional — it’s essential.
Advancing the science of pain

We pursue innovation with integrity — turning data into hope and science into access. Our breakthroughs don’t just relieve pain; they restore possibility. Our goal is to set a new standard of care, not just meet the existing one.
Pioneer your future with us
Innovation and leadership drive our culture, empowering everyone to make a difference and excel together. At Pacira, you’ll lead your journey. Start today.

pages.raw_meta: Partner with us to advance innovative, non-opioid pain management. Explore opportunities in business development, procurement, grants and corporate giving.
raw_blocks: Collaboration drives innovation. At Pacira, we build partnerships rooted in a shared mission to advance non-opioid pain management—uniting purpose, urgency and results to deliver transformative care for patients.

Pacira seeks to transform the lives of patients by delivering innovative, non-opioid pain therapies to the market. Our business development team evaluates opportunities in the musculoskeletal and pain adjacencies across two broad categories.

We’re interested in innovative assets that focus on non-opioid or opioid-sparing pain management, including products that complement our current portfolio or could gain value from our field expertise, existing partnerships and commercial infrastructure.
Call points span hospital, outpatient (HOPD), ambulatory surgery centers (ASC), and specialty or office settings
Fields include anesthesiology, orthopedics (including surgery), rheumatology, sports medicine, pain management, dental (oral and maxillofacial surgery) and plastic surgery
We’re open to the opportunity for collaboration or co-marketing as well as asset acquisition or license.
Development-stage assets with clinical data
We also seek innovative development-stage assets, with preference for later-stage assets with clinical data and proof of mechanism.
Strategic areas include diabetic peripheral neuropathy, chemotherapy-induced neuropathy and other types of neuropathic pain; pain adjacencies (e.g., gout, fibromyalgia); and osteoarthritis.
We’re open to asset acquisition as well as collaboration based on co-development and other shared activities and investments.
We invite companies and researchers who share our purpose and sense of urgency to contact our Business Development team at [email protected] to discuss partnership opportunities.

At Pacira, we follow a rigorous process to select vendors who align with our mission and share our commitment to innovation, sustainability and operational excellence. For more information, review our Supplier Code of Conduct and other sustainability policies .

Spending areas include research and development, clinical operations, professional services, IT, travel services, contingent workforce, direct materials-manufacturing, supply chain-distribution, and real estate and facilities management
To inquire about our procurement and supply chain efforts, please complete the form below.
Through grants and charitable giving, we support research, education and medical missions that bring meaningful change to communities worldwide.
Support for studies led by principal investigators and institutions to drive innovation and improve patient care.
Medical missions and charitable contributions
Support for healthcare providers offering free medical care in local and global communities.
Support for CME and non-CME programs hosted by academic centers, hospitals, independent providers and professional associations.

Pacira BioSciences, Inc. is dedicated to supporting independent research and educational initiatives that advance scientific knowledge and improve patient care. This includes investigator-initiated trials (IITs) that explore the safety, efficacy, pharmacology, and tolerability of our marketed products within therapeutic areas of interest. We also provide grants for educational programs and activities, such as conferences, seminars, live events, and online presentations, that align with the therapeutic areas and disease states addressed by our products.

All grant requests are subject to review for compliance with internal policies and applicable legal and industry requirements, including guidance from the Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education (ACCME), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and the Pharmaceutical Research and Manufacturers of America (PhRMA). Submission of a request does not guarantee support. Final decisions are made by the Pacira Grant Review Committee, and applicants will be notified of the outcome via email after the review process is complete.

To submit your grant proposal, click on one of the applicable buttons below. You will be prompted to create an account and submit detailed information about your grant proposal. This will streamline managing and evaluating your proposal.
Submit an IIT request Apply for a Medical-Educational Grant
For any questions or inquiries about grants and funding opportunities, please contact us at [email protected] .
